ordered_operations: move the exact Dizzy Spell to hand
activate transmute through the shared ActionBroker without a tutor identity in the activation arguments
pay mana and discard the source as costs
resolve the ability by selecting zero or one eligible identity
reveal and move the selected singleton to hand if found
preconditions: The scenario is constructed with build_exact_game().
The exact deck contains one Sol Ring.
The strategic choice provider is frozen before activation.
required_assertions: the broker exposes one activation with choice timing RESOLUTION
no tutor choice is recorded before resolution
exactly one singleton Sol Ring enters hand in the positive scenario
the selected record identifies the frozen evaluator and RESOLUTION timing
wrong-mana-value identities are never offered and fail-to-find remains legal

plain_english: The exact frozen deck contains one Dizzy Spell and one Sol Ring.
Transmute is activated at sorcery speed and discards Dizzy Spell as a cost without precommitting a card identity.
During resolution, the frozen policy selects at most one eligible identity, the selected card is revealed and moved to hand, and the library is shuffled; failing to find remains legal.
title: Exact-deck transmute chooses one singleton card during resolution
